map.地中海饮食依从性评分 = 14 项每项 0 至 1 分之和（橄榄油为主、橄榄油用: The Mediterranean diet adherence score = the sum of 14 items scored 0 to 1 each (olive oil as the main fat, adequate olive oil intake, adequate vegetables, adequate fruit, little red meat, little butter, few sugary drinks, few sweets, adequate fish, adequate beans, adequate nuts, adequate whole grains, poultry over red meat, moderate red wine), for a maximum of 14. Adherence = total score ÷ 14 × 100%. At least 70% means high, 40% to 69% means moderate and below 40% means low.
map.地中海饮食14项依从性评分（每项0-1分，满分14）: Mediterranean diet adherence score across 14 items (0 to 1 point each, 14 points maximum)
map.1. 使用橄榄油作为主要烹饪油脂: 1. Use olive oil as the main cooking fat
map.2. 每日使用橄榄油≥4汤匙: 2. Use at least 4 tablespoons of olive oil per day
map.3. 每日蔬菜≥2份（每份200g）: 3. At least 2 servings of vegetables per day (200 g each)
map.4. 每日水果≥3份（含1份柑橘类）: 4. At least 3 servings of fruit per day (including 1 serving of citrus)
map.5. 每周红肉/肉制品<1次: 5. Red meat or processed meat fewer than once a week
map.6. 每周黄油/奶油<1次: 6. Butter or cream fewer than once a week
map.7. 每周含糖饮料<1次: 7. Sugary drinks fewer than once a week
map.8. 每周甜食/糕点<2次: 8. Sweets or pastries fewer than twice a week
map.9. 每周鱼/海鲜≥3次: 9. Fish or seafood at least 3 times a week
map.10. 每周豆类≥3次: 10. Beans at least 3 times a week
map.11. 每周坚果≥3次（每次30g）: 11. Nuts at least 3 times a week (30 g each)
map.12. 每周全谷物/面食≥3次: 12. Whole grains or pasta at least 3 times a week
map.13. 每周禽肉优于红肉（禽>红肉）: 13. Poultry preferred over red meat each week (poultry > red meat)
map.14. 每日用餐佐以适量红酒（女性1杯/男性2杯，可选）: 14. Moderate red wine with meals each day (1 glass for women, 2 for men, optional)
